description: A variable holding a tuple can't be params, which must be written as a tuple
notes: The README writes params as a tuple of bare names, which only reading it statically allows, but the package documentation's example writes params = ["name"], which evaluating it would also allow, and then a variable holding a tuple of names would do too. hashicorp/hcl requires a static list (hcl.ExprList in decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go).
reference_error: A static list expression is required
